name: Android Studio
description: Automate any Android device or emulator over ADB — tap, swipe, type, screenshot, install/inspect apps, push and pull files — reached through a linked host via aw-remote-hosts. No fixed machine: point it at whichever remote host and adb binary you configure, per-call overrides included.

skills.description: Automate an Android device/emulator over ADB via a linked aw-remote-hosts machine — finding the device, tap/swipe by coordinate, screenshotting and pulling it into the workspace, installing/launching apps. Use for anything about "the Android emulator", ADB automation, or piloting an Android app.

remote_backend_url.description: aw-backend base URL that fronts aw-remote-hosts, e.g. https://api.aw.tekflox.com. Every adb call and file transfer goes through {url}/api/workspaces/{remote_workspace}/remote-hosts/{remote_host_id}/... . Set all three remote_backend_url/remote_workspace/remote_token or none — with any one missing the tools fail explicitly naming what's absent rather than guessing a host.

remote_workspace.description: The CALLING workspace's own slug (e.g. 'aw') — NOT the slug the target host happens to be registered under. aw-backend resolves host ownership server-side, so a host linked to a different workspace of yours is still reached via this workspace's own slug. Using the host's slug here returns 401.

remote_token.description: Bearer token for aw-backend — this workspace's AW_WORKSPACE_HOST_TOKEN (from the aw-remote-host /link handshake). Routed to the zero-knowledge secret store via POST /api/apps/android-studio/settings — never stored in plain config.

remote_host_id.description: Id of the linked host running adb, from 'aw-workspace-cli remote-hosts hosts'. Defaults to Frederico's Mac.Home. Every tool accepts a per-call remote_host_id override.

adb_path.description: Full path to the adb binary on the REMOTE host's filesystem — adb is typically not on PATH in that machine's non-interactive exec shell. A leading ~ is expanded against the remote host's own home, not this workspace's. Every tool accepts a per-call adb_path override.

default_device_serial.description: Optional device/emulator serial (as shown by adb_devices) to target when the remote host has more than one device attached. Leave empty when only one device is attached — adb targets it automatically. Every tool accepts a per-call device override.

screenshot_dir.description: Directory on THIS workspace's own filesystem where adb_screenshot saves PNGs, relative to the workspace root. Every call accepts a local_path override.

apps.reason: This app contributes an mcp.json entry (the 'aw-android-studio' server) that MCP Gateway discovers and merges; without the gateway no agent can reach its tools.

dependencies.note: Runtime-enforced app dependency: aw-workspace loads mcp-gateway before this app so the gateway can scan android-studio/mcp.json.
